diagnosis: Schematic diagram of breast implant–associated anaplastic large cell lymphoma
legend: Lymphoma cells are found in the effusion fluid accumulated between the breast implant and the outer fibrous capsule, as well as along the luminal aspect of the fibrous capsule.

legend: Gross appearance of a capsule involved by breast implant–associated ALCL. The luminal surface has a fibrinoid appearance, but a distinct lesion is not identified. Microscopic examination reveals tumour cells along the luminal side of the capsule.
Immunohistochemistry for CD30 highlights the neoplastic cells in a case with an abundant reactive infiltrate, mimicking Hodgkin lymphoma.
A cell block specimen of the effusion around a breast implant shows large cells with vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli, and abundant cytoplasm.

diagnosis: Breast implant–associated anaplastic large cell lymphoma with axillary lymph node involvement
legend: The lymph node shows hyperplastic changes and sinusoidal distribution of large neoplastic cells.

diagnosis: Breast implant–associated anaplastic large cell lymphoma with axillary lymph node involvement
legend: Immunohistochemistry for CD30 highlights the membranes and Golgi bodies of neoplastic cells in the subcapsular sinus.

diagnosis: Breast implant–associated anaplastic large cell lymphoma, pathological stage T1, along the luminal side of the capsule
legend: There is a layer of fibrin and necrotic cells, with only a subset of viable cells.

The cytological features of an FNA smear of the effusion around a breast implant include numerous cells with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm and large nuclei with prominent nucleoli. Small lymphocytes and histiocytes are noted in the background (Wright–Giemsa stain).

diagnosis: Breast implant–associated anaplastic large cell lymphoma, pathological stage T4, involving the luminal side of the capsule and invading into surrounding soft tissue
legend: The luminal side appears granular and the tumour mass extends into the surrounding soft tissue.

diagnosis: Breast implant–associated anaplastic large cell lymphoma, pathological stage T4, involving the luminal side of the capsule and invading into surrounding soft tissue
legend: CD30 immunohistochemistry highlights abundant cells and necrotic debris on the luminal side, as well as the tumour cells forming a mass around the capsule.

diagnosis: Breast implant–associated anaplastic large cell lymphoma, pathological stage T4. Microscopic detail of lymphoma cells
legend: The neoplastic cells most commonly appear as sheets of large cells with pleomorphic nuclei and prominent nucleoli.

diagnosis: Breast implant–associated anaplastic large cell lymphoma, pathological stage T4. Microscopic detail of lymphoma cells
legend: The neoplastic cells most commonly appear as sheets of large cells with pleomorphic nuclei and prominent nucleoli (see <<#1933>>Fig. 6.XXX). Less frequently, there is a dense inflammatory infiltrate around tumour cells as shown here, mimicking Hodgkin lymphoma.
Immunohistochemistry for phosphorylated STAT3 highlights most cells, supporting JAK/STAT pathway activation in most cases.

diagnosis: Breast implant–associated anaplastic large cell lymphoma, pathological stage T1, along the luminal side of the capsule
legend: CD30 immunohistochemistry highlights the tumour cells, necrotic cells, and debris along the luminal side of the capsule.
